summary: Trump announces unprecedented economic warfare against Iran with secondary sanctions on nations aiding Tehran, while Israeli airstrikes hit southern Lebanon and IDF reinforces northern airpower. Western powers condemn Israeli settlement expansion in E1, and IRGC threatens more destructive weapons in any future conflict.
key_points: Trump declares harshest-ever economic operation against Iran, warning all countries against providing financial lifelines to Tehran. (Source: @asafroz/52583)
Israeli forces conduct airstrikes on Kfar Roummane and Ali al-Taher Heights in southern Lebanon. (Source: @presstv/203601)
IDF completes transfer of Squadron 190 'Magic Touch' to Ramat David base to enhance firepower and northern defense. (Source: @idf_telegram/24939)
US Ambassador Huckabee says settlers involved in siege on Palestinian-American homes in Qusra may face US sanctions. (Source: @asafroz/52600)
Seven Western countries condemn Israel's new E1 settlement tender in West Bank as violation of international law. (Source: @SharghDaily/179122)
IRGC spokesman vows to employ more destructive weapons if new war erupts. (Source: @kianmeli1/90943)
Two Iranian IRGC members and one Iraqi linked to IRGC killed in clashes with Yemeni government forces. (Source: @kianmeli1/90948)
US Treasury Secretary Bessent states sanctions aim to overthrow Iran's government, warns allies to choose sides. (Source: @VahidOnline/77973)

sections.executive_summary: Trump has launched an unprecedented economic campaign against Iran, threatening secondary sanctions on any nation facilitating Iranian oil smuggling, financial channels, or sanctions evasion. Simultaneously, Israeli airstrikes struck southern Lebanon while the IDF repositioned a combat helicopter squadron to Ramat David for northern defense. Western powers jointly condemned Israel's E1 settlement expansion, and IRGC leadership signaled readiness to deploy more destructive weaponry in any future confrontation.

points: Trump announced the 'harshest economic operation ever taken against any country,' targeting Iranian oil smuggling, exchange houses, cash transfers, ship registries, and front companies, and warned all nations that providing financial lifelines to Iran will incur severe economic consequences. (Source: @asafroz/52583)
US Treasury imposed new sanctions on three individuals linked to Iran and seven linked to Hezbollah, alongside designations related to Cuba and Russia. (Source: @SharghDaily/179123)
IRGC spokesman declared that in any new war, the force will employ 'more destructive weapons,' signaling an escalation in threatened capabilities. (Source: @kianmeli1/90943)
Iran's Defense Ministry stated it is modernizing its defense industry based on lessons from recent wars imposed by the US and Israel. (Source: @presstv/203603)
Vice President JD Vance identified the Strait of Hormuz as Iran's primary leverage, saying economic pressure is altering Tehran's calculations on a potential deal. (Source: @SharghDaily/179132)

Treasury Secretary Bessent said the sanctions plan aims to 'overthrow' the Islamic Republic and warned allies they must choose between siding with Washington or facing opposition. (Source: @VahidOnline/77973)
A fuel tanker exploded at the Tehran refinery, though details on cause or casualties were not provided. (Source: @kianmeli1/90946)
Israeli forces carried out airstrikes targeting the southern Lebanese town of Kfar Roummane and the Ali al-Taher Heights. (Source: @presstv/203601)

The Prime Minister's Office clarified that the political echelon has not approved entry of any international force into Gaza and reiterated that no reconstruction will occur before Hamas is fully disarmed. (Source: @almogboker78/18008)

The IDF completed the transfer of Squadron 190 'Magic Touch' (combat helicopters) to Ramat David airbase to improve firepower availability and strengthen northern defense. (Source: @idf_telegram/24939)

US Ambassador Mike Huckabee stated settlers who participated in the siege on Palestinian-American homes in Qusra may face US sanctions, including visa bans, and called the settler actions 'unbearable and reprehensible criminal activity.' (Source: @asafroz/52600)
During an IDF offensive in Jenin, an armed Palestinian with a knife attempted to stab a soldier and was shot dead; no Israeli casualties reported. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94197)

Seven Western nations (UK, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Norway) jointly condemned Israel's publication of tenders for the E1 settlement project in the West Bank, calling it a violation of international law. (Source: @SharghDaily/179122, @New_security8200/203380)
Israeli PMO ruled out any international force entering Gaza and insisted no reconstruction will begin until Hamas is fully disarmed. (Source: @almogboker78/18008)
IDF forces operating in Jenin killed a knife-wielding attacker; no Israeli injuries. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94197)
US Ambassador Huckabee warned that settlers involved in the siege on Palestinian-American families in Qusra could face American sanctions. (Source: @asafroz/52600)
Western powers condemned Israel's E1 settlement tender publication, demanding immediate reversal. (Source: @SharghDaily/179122, @New_security8200/203380)
Israeli airstrikes hit Kfar Roummane and Ali al-Taher Heights in southern Lebanon. (Source: @presstv/203601)
Arabic-language channels reported intensive warplane activity over the southern and central sectors at maximum alert levels. (Source: @redlinkleb/37695, @redlinkleb/37699)
Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf visited the Imam Hussein shrine in Karbala, Iraq. (Source: @presstv/203597)
Two Iranian IRGC members and one Iraqi national linked to the IRGC were killed in clashes with Yemeni government forces. (Source: @kianmeli1/90948)
Trump described Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE, Kuwait, and Bahrain as 'sort of semi-neutral countries.' (Source: @presstv/203595)
US Treasury Secretary Bessent warned Gulf allies they must choose between joining the US economic isolation campaign against Iran or opposing it. (Source: @VahidOnline/77973)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of maximum-pressure US economic sanctions targeting Iran's entire financial and oil infrastructure with explicit regime-change rhetoric from Treasury Secretary Bessent creates a high probability of Iranian asymmetric retaliation, potentially through proxy forces in Lebanon, Yemen, or Iraq. Israel's simultaneous airstrikes in Lebanon and forward deployment of attack helicopters to Ramat David suggest preparation for a northern escalation scenario. The IRGC's public threat to employ 'more destructive weapons' indicates a lowered threshold for advanced weaponry use. Meanwhile, settler violence in the West Bank drawing US sanctions threats adds a new dimension of friction between Washington and Jerusalem. The killing of IRGC personnel in Yemen demonstrates the expanding geographic scope of Iranian-linked militia operations.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states face a stark choice as Bessent demands alignment with the US sanctions regime, with Trump publicly labeling them 'semi-neutral.' The joint Western condemnation of E1 settlements signals diplomatic isolation for Israel on settlement policy, yet no concrete measures were announced. Lebanon's southern border remains volatile with Israeli strikes and reported intense overflight activity. Iraq hosts high-level Iranian visits while Iranian-backed elements operate in Yemen. The absence of a unified Arab position on Iran sanctions suggests fragmented regional cohesion.
sections.intelligence_notes: The fuel tanker explosion at Tehran refinery warrants monitoring for potential sabotage or accident amid heightened tensions. The UKMTO maritime warning (118-26) may indicate Red Sea shipping risks from Houthi activity, though details are unspecified. The transfer of Squadron 190 to Ramat David reduces response times to Lebanese and Syrian targets. US sanctions on settlers represent a potential precedent for targeting Israeli citizens. The IRGC's modernization claim suggests ongoing indigenous weapons development despite sanctions. The killing of an Iraqi IRGC-linked figure in Yemen highlights the transnational nature of Iran's proxy network.
